title: देशभक्तिका आधुनिक नेपाली गीतमा शिल्पविधान
nepali: प्रस्तुत अध्ययन आधुनिक नेपाली गीतमा प्रयुक्त शिल्पपद्धतिको वस्तुनिष्ठ विश्लेषणसँग सम्बन्धित छ । यसमा देशभक्तिको सैद्धान्तिक सन्दर्भ र गीतितत्वलाई आधार बनाउँदै २००० देखि २०२० सम्मका नेपाली गीतको स्वच्छन्दतावादी गीतिधारा र प्रगतिवादी गीतिधाराका २५ ओटा विवेच्य गीतबाट तथ्याङ्क सङ्कलन गरी देशभक्तिका गीतलाई आस्वाद्य बनाउने शिल्पकौशलको सम्यक् मूल्याङ्कन गरिएको छ । देशभक्तिका आधुनिक नेपाली गीतको चयन गर्दा ऐतिहासिक घटना तथा वीर पूर्वजप्रति गर्वको अनुभव, देशको राष्ट्रिय सम्पदाप्रति आकर्षण र प्राकृतिक परिवेशप्रतिको मोहलाई सूचकका रूपमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । गीतिकौशलको विश्लेषणका निम्ति गीतितत्वमा केन्द्रित हुँदै मूलतः अप्रस्तुतविधान, लयविधान र भाषाप्रयोगलाई प्रमुख आधार बनाइएको छ । प्रस्तुत अध्ययनमा देशक्तिका गीतको सौन्दर्य उच्च बनाउने शिल्पगत कारक गीतमा प्रयुक्त श्रुतिरम्य, अनुप्रासयुक्त, साङ्गीतिक, कोमल पदपदावलीको प्रयोग, लोकलयको संयोजन र रूपक, उपमा, मानवीकरण तथा सरल स्वयम् पारदर्शक बिम्बालङ्कारहरूको प्रयोग जस्ता रूपतात्विक प्रविधि नै हुन् भन्ने निष्कर्ष प्रस्तुत भएको छ ।
american_english: The present study is concerned with an objective analysis of the craft techniques employed in modern Nepali songs. In this, taking the theoretical context of patriotism and lyric elements as a foundation, data was collected from 25 analyzed songs from the romantic lyric stream and progressive lyric stream of Nepali songs from 2000 to 2020, and a comprehensive evaluation of the craftsmanship that makes patriotic songs enjoyable was carried out. When selecting modern Nepali patriotic songs, a sense of pride in historical events and heroic ancestors, attraction toward the nation's national heritage, and affection for the natural environment were presented as indicators. For the analysis of lyrical craft, focusing on lyric elements, indirect presentation, rhythmic design, and language usage were made the primary foundation. In the present study, the conclusion is presented that the craft factors elevating the beauty of patriotic songs are indeed formalistic techniques such as the use of euphonious, alliterative, musical, and gentle diction, the integration of folk rhythms, and the use of metaphor, simile, personification, and simple, self-evident imagery and figures of speech.

informal_english: This study is basically all about an objective analysis of the craft techniques used in modern Nepali songs. In this, building on the theoretical context of patriotism and songwriting elements, data was drawn from 25 selected songs across the romantic and progressive lyric streams of Nepali songs from 2000 to 2020, giving a proper, solid evaluation of the craftsmanship that makes patriotic songs such a lekker listen. When selecting modern Nepali patriotic songs, feeling proud of historic events and brave ancestors, being drawn to the country's national heritage, and love for the natural scenery were used as indicators. To analyse the lyrical craft, keeping an eye on lyric elements, indirect presentation, rhythmic setup, and language use were taken as the main basis. In this study, the conclusion is that the craft factors boosting the beauty of patriotic songs are formal techniques like using smooth, alliterative, musical, and gentle phrasing, blending in folk tunes, and using metaphors, similes, personification, and simple, totally clear imagery.
